original.voice: The Giving Garden is a nonprofit farm.
We grow sustainable food for our community.
We are looking for volunteers to help on the farm.
Visit the link in our bio to sign up.

revised.voice: Last season, we couldn't harvest it all.
We had less than half the volunteers we needed.

revised.onScreen: One morning. Real food. Real people.
revised.voice: Give us one morning, and help get fresh food to real people.
Sign up at the link in our bio. Bring a friend.
